bookdraftSync.scope: Add Purchase Journal direct invoice laboratory route with Preview, controlled posting and ledger trace.

decision.reason: P2P-032 proves a standalone Purchase Journal invoice posting route with clean Journal Check, Preview Posting, visible Post dialog and Vendor/G-L/Detailed Vendor Ledger trace. It is useful for the book as a laboratory alternative to Purchase Order flow, but it is not a German final proof and not a partial receipt proof.

proves: A Purchase Journal line can be posted as a controlled RM-DEMO laboratory P2P invoice route.
The resulting Vendor Ledger, Detailed Vendor Ledger and G/L Entries are visible by document number.
The P2P lab draft may now teach the difference between Purchase Order flow and direct Purchase Journal invoice posting.
notProved: No item ledger or value entry, because Purchase Journal was a G/L balancing route rather than item receipt.
nextStep: P2P-034 should integrate this lab route into the book master or continue with a bounded German-final-rebuild map; do not claim this as German final proof.
